title: MS Capital张凯：AI如何增强量化策略与风控？
speaker: Kate Zhang

segments.en: I mean, it's quite remarkable because as we understand it, fast-moving markets, your models have been able to pick up some of these shifts.
segments.zh: 这相当了不起，因为据我们了解，在快速变动的市场中，你们的模型能够捕捉到一些变化。

segments.en: Can you walk us through how exactly they're being structured to be able to do this? Yes.
segments.zh: 你能详细介绍一下它们是如何构建来实现这一点的吗？是的。

segments.en: I think we have a very disciplined process of making the strategy.
segments.zh: 我认为我们有一个非常严谨的策略制定流程。

segments.en: We first, we process the data and then we identify the pattern.
segments.zh: 我们首先处理数据，然后识别模式。

segments.en: Then we have a vigorous risk control management.
segments.zh: 然后我们有严格的风险控制管理。

segments.en: So I think the whole process is also enhanced by AI.
segments.zh: 所以我认为整个过程也由AI增强。

segments.en: Now we even developed our own LLN to read and interpret this signal into our own pattern.
segments.zh: 现在我们甚至开发了自己的LLN来读取和解读这些信号，形成我们自己的模式。

segments.en: And then we adapted all these factors, all these strategies due to the market regime.
segments.zh: 然后我们根据市场状态调整所有这些因子和策略。

segments.en: And how exactly is AI helping with the risk assessment side of the process? You talk about these LLMs.
segments.zh: AI在风险评估方面具体如何帮助？你谈到这些LLM。
